senses.gloss: dark-red stain, esp. stain on a woman’s clothes or body, as an indication of uncleanness (v. נִדָּה).
units: <cite ref="Niddah 4b:54">Nidd. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>כִּתְמָהּ טמא למפרע</he> a stain found on her makes her unclean retrospectively (up to the time when she last washed herself).
Ib. 5ᵃ יש לה כ׳ is subject to the law concerning kethem.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 8:1">Ib. VIII, 1</cite>. Y. ib. I, 49ᶜ <he>אין לה כ׳</he> is not subject to the law &c., v. supra; a. fr.—Pl. <he>כְּתָמִים</he>, <he>כְּתָמִין</he>. Ib. VII, 3, sq.
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 8:12">Tosef. ib. VIII, 12</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 8:1">Ex. R. s. 8</cite>; Tanḥ. Vaëra 8, v. <cite ref="Q00420"><he>פָּז</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 4a:8">R. Hash. 4ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 45:10">Ps. XLV, 10</cite>) <he>זכיתם לכ׳ אופיר</he> you are rewarded with gold of Ophir.
